shots.excerpt: Medium shot across the grill, locked-off. She pours batter from a dented kettle; a grey-skinned zombie grabs her and she flips him over her back without looking up.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A locked-off shot across the grill. She flips the zombie over her shoulder without even looking up.

shots.excerpt: Wide shot from the road side at knee height. She crouches by the cooler; two zombies charge from left and right and slam into each other above her head.
highlight: slam into each other above her head
shots.voice: Shot 3. A low wide shot. She just crouches, and the two zombies crash into each other right above her.

shots.excerpt: Medium side-angle over the grill: she spoons red-bean paste into the moulds and flips out golden pastries. Must show: two zombies wrestling out of focus behind her.
shots.voice: Shot 5. The pastries come out golden, while two zombies wrestle in the blurry background. She never turns around.

shots.excerpt: Wide frontal shot, she stands dead centre holding the paper bag; two zombies lunge from both sides and crash head-first into each other. She does not blink.
shots.voice: Shot 6. A symmetrical wide shot. Two zombies crash into each other in front of her, and she doesn't move at all.

shots.excerpt: Medium two-shot, frontal, warm amber basement: she and the older girl eat pastries side by side; she breaks into a small satisfied smile.
shots.voice: Shot 10. The warm amber basement. The whole mission was just to feed the kids, and she finally smiles.
